name: 31754-decode-357b-8gpu
parallelism: TP=8 with expert parallelism (`--enable-expert-parallel`), PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine on one node.
architecture: Glm4MoeForCausalLM, ~357B total parameters, sparse MoE (160 routed experts + 1 shared, 8 active per token), compressed-tensors fp8; 337 GiB of safetensors.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=128, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 6400 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, static seed 31754.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`: 2 prompt tokens and 128 output tokens per request, min == max == mean on both, temperature 0. The engine renders and tokenizes the prompt, so a report may show a prompt length a token or two above 2; that is not drift.
purpose: A creative writing helper expanding tiny prompts into 128-token passages for 128 concurrent users on eight GPUs.
launch:
# dtype, quantization, enforce-eager, max-num-batched-tokens and the all2all backend are
# deliberately absent: they are left to the checkpoint and to the engine's own defaults.

model: zai-org/GLM-4.7-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true
max-num-seqs: 128
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
